author: Robin & Victoria
title: La Joya Police Arrest Man For Assaulting Officer - NewsBreak
text:
By Robin & Victoria ,
14 hours ago In La Joya, Texas, a recent altercation between law enforcement and a resident has brought attention to the risks police officers face daily on the job. The incident unfolded when La Joya Police responded to a domestic disturbance call, an encounter which led to the arrest of 20-year-old Eric Manuayad. This case highlights the challenges law enforcement officers confront and the legal repercussions of non-compliance and aggression towards officers. Read full article
